info.name: Retrieves a list of libraries in the tenant portfolio.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of elements that should be returned in a single page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the last page, to get the following page with the same filters applied.

params.name: key
params.description: Filter by asset key(s), comma separated.

params.name: type
params.description:
Filter by asset type(s), comma separated.
Available values: LowCodeLibrary, ExtensionLibrary, ExternalLibrary, WidgetLibrary, MobileLibrary.

params.name: nameContains
params.description: Filter by matching on the name, case-insensitive.

params.name: permissionFilter
params.description: Filter by permission type. Format: 'PermissionType' or 'PermissionType.EnvironmentKey'.

params.name: sort
params.description:
Sort order. Format: Field:asc or Field:desc. Supported fields: Name, PublishDateTime.
Example: sort=Name:asc or sort=PublishDateTime:desc.

params.name: portfolioKey
params.description: Filter by portfolio key. Returns only libraries belonging to this portfolio.

params.name: revisions
params.description:
Which revisions to return per library: 'latest' (default), 'highestTag', or 'all'.
'highestTag' selects the tagged revision with the highest SemVer (Major.Minor.Patch) version.

items.docs:
Retrieves all libraries available in the tenant portfolio, including their latest revision
and all tagged revisions. Each library exposes the portfolio it belongs to and can be
filtered by portfolio key.

API client must have at least one permission.
